decisions.reason: Uses the contrast probe and symptom log to rule out disk, path and renderer causes because file-trace's own RPC reads the same file. Places the fault in the workspace-files Remote/provider chain and notes that meta.status staying at none means the read never started.

Correctly treats the per-module 62/62 sweep as valid and the oversized joined URL's 404 as a length-limit artifact, not missing modules. But it says the loader fetches one URL per module instead of describing bounded batching under a URL limit, and it never mentions the 60-versus-62 entry-count discrepancy.

Treats the paste-input fold warnings as an unrelated plugin-local issue. Explains the textpreview-to-documentpreview rename and the session-only canOpen as the cause of the absolute-address dialog, not of the stalled metadata.
Orders the steps as restart, then rollback to 0.1.3-alpha.2, then upstream. Rejects rewrite, retry and fallback, and treats the alpha.1 roster mismatch as prior art that this boot rules out.

The forensics package covers versions, profile history, addresses, the roster, the valid sweep with the invalid-join caveat, the contrast probe and meta.status. It proposes a named post-boot provider-chain self-test and inject verification.

caps.reason: Explicitly says the joined-URL 404 must not be read as missing modules.
Rejects plugin rewrite, retry and fallback. The interim step of reading files in the file-trace panel is a manual user action, not a code workaround or a duplicate service.
